guides.favoredWhen: Keep him at Volley range; never let him set the short-trade terms.

keyTips.text: Your range is the problem he cannot solve. Hold max distance and make every trade happen at your auto range, never at his.
He trades only in flashes of Q plus the fourth shot, then leaves. Answer the burst, then re-engage while his shots are spent.
He rushes Swiftness and takes Fleet plus Cleanse into you. Respect that setup: hold Volley ({cd:22:W}) slows for real commits and hold your arrow for the guaranteed hit, not poke.

early-lane.text: Jhin loads his fourth shot on a minion and holds it to zone you off the wave. Trade while it is spent and give ground while it is held.
Deadly Flourish is a follow-up for support crowd control, not dry poke. A wasted W is your window to walk up.

win-condition.text: A landed Deadly Flourish sets up a guaranteed first Curtain Call shot when fired instantly. Break vision lines and stay mobile once it connects.

tips.text: Keep Volley pressure on the wave. He must wait for its cooldown to engage, so never give him a free window without it.
Trade while his fourth shot is spent and give ground while he holds it. The loaded shot zones you off the wave even without firing.
Walk up when he wastes Deadly Flourish ({cd:202:W}) dry. Without the follow-up root he has no answer to your slows.
Force the long game at your range. He avoids fighting and wants only brief trades, so extended slow pressure breaks him.
Sweep the objective flanks for his traps and fog picks. Denied vision denies his casts, and he cannot set up what he cannot see.
Force his Cleanse with slows first, then land the arrow while it is down. The kill chain only works in that order against his setup.
Break vision and stay mobile once his root connects. The instant Curtain Call shot after it is guaranteed unless you are already moving.

itemization.text: Spend for fight damage, not utility. His whole plan is avoiding you, so raw stats that win the fights he cannot refuse beat extra slow tools.

keyTips.text: Control the wave and vision before stepping up to trade, since Ashe has no mobility escape.
Kite with passive slows and hold enough distance to make up for the missing escape.
Fire R only when allies stand ready to act on the stun.

tips.text: Slow a target with an attack before a close-range R, since the shorter reaction window lands the stun more reliably.
When lane pressure gets hard, freeze and farm safely while scaling toward the later timing.
Send E ahead before pushing or rotating to an objective; vision that finds a kill can also add an assist.
Use E to track enemy rotations so the team never walks blind into an unseen move.
Open plays with long-range R for teammates, then stay positioned to follow with slows and steady attacks.
Use R to enable teammates or rescue a fight rather than spending it with no follow-up.
Scout with E before a push or objective, then catch a priority target with R for the team to convert.
After scaling, stay with the team and deal sustained damage from safety instead of chasing past the frontline.
